name: Hazel's Brewmaster exiling Devoted Druid -> infinite green mana on a Food token

prerequisites.timing: Hazel's Brewmaster's 'enters or attacks' trigger must resolve targeting Devoted Druid in a graveyard; Hazel's Brewmaster must remain on the battlefield afterward for the static ability-grant to keep applying.
targets_required: Hazel's Brewmaster's trigger targets 'up to one target card from a graveyard' - target Devoted Druid, wherever it is.
other: Devoted Druid's oracle text: '{T}: Add {G}.' and 'Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: Untap this creature.' - both activated abilities.

Official Scryfall ruling on Hazel's Brewmaster (2024-07-26): 'Hazel's Brewmaster's last ability grants only activated abilities... The granted abilities effectively use "this permanent" rather than "[that card's name]"... For example, say you exiled the card Argothian Sprite with Hazel's Brewmaster... you'd treat it as though it had the ability "{7}: Put two +1/+1 counters on Gingerbrute."' - confirms the mechanism this interaction depends on.
Ruling (2024-11-08): 'Food is an artifact type. Even though it appears on some creatures, it's never a creature type.' A plain Food token gaining these abilities is not a creature.

Consequence: the granted 'Put a -1/-1 counter on this [Food]: Untap this [Food]' ability places -1/-1 counters on a non-creature permanent. CR 704.5f ('a creature with toughness 0 or less is put into its owner's graveyard') applies only to creatures (same mechanism as INT-0002), so a Food accumulating -1/-1 counters never dies from this.

This gives a Food a mana-cost-free untap: tap for the granted '{T}: Add {G}', pay the granted 'put a -1/-1 counter' cost (no mana) to untap, repeat - unbounded green mana, no natural termination other than voluntary stop.
Devoted Druid never needs to resolve as a creature on the battlefield - only to end up in a graveyard (self-mill, discard, or dying) and be the card Hazel's Brewmaster's trigger targets.
Fully deck-controlled: requires only this player's own board state (Hazel's Brewmaster resolved + Devoted Druid in a graveyard), no opponent decision at any step - conditional: false.

Not yet reproduced in an executable engine this session (effort prioritized toward Gate 2/3 progress); RULES_VERIFIED on Comprehensive Rules + an official ruling directly on point, which is unusually strong non-engine evidence. Engine reproduction is a candidate for later, non-blocking follow-up, not required for Gate 1 sufficiency.

result.summary: Unbounded (infinite, subject to voluntary player choice to stop) green mana production from a single Food token, once Hazel's Brewmaster has exiled Devoted Druid from any graveyard.
result.loop_termination: Does not terminate on its own; stopped only by voluntary player choice, removal of Hazel's Brewmaster (ends the ability grant), or removal of the Food token.

rules_citations: CR 704.5f - state-based action putting a 0-toughness creature into the graveyard applies only to creatures.
CR 121 - counters may be placed on any permanent, not creature-restricted.

sources.reference: Independent reasoning about Hazel's Brewmaster's ability-granting text applied to Devoted Druid's two activated abilities.
